_about: Settings for the automatic per-submission job (assessment/auto/run-auto.js). It judges new submissions with Claude Code headless and puts each confirmed report on the survey page (uploadReports, surveyUrl; needs the same RESULTS_TOKEN here, in assessment/auto/results-token.txt or the environment, and on Render). People see "Your report is ready" on the page; no email is used. onlyEmails: when not empty, only submissions from these addresses are handled (for testing).
